content: Got a HP smart printer 5101 a couple months ago and ive only got it to run with out having to reconnect the printer to the app for like 1 week at time. Since moving the printer almost never connects to the “HP smart” app as directed. I’ve spent two days trying to put the stupid product in start up mode but the app doesn’t even detect there’s a printer anywhere. The best part is when I try to make a repair order it takes me out of the app just to bring me to the App Store FOR THE SAME APP. It’s just a really bad product. If you put your printer in start up mode then you should be able to make a new device. I guess the HP smart app isn’t as smart as it says. 👎👎👎👎
